main.description: Main settings/history window. No shell, no remote content, no fs access — everything privileged happens in the Rust core behind typed IPC commands.

overlay.description: Focusless always-on-top dictation overlay. Least privilege: core IPC only; it can never touch the network, files, or clipboard on its own.

snippet.description: Full-screen snippet-OCR selection overlay (Proposal 100). It renders a scaled preview of the frozen frame and reports a selection rect. Least privilege: core IPC only; it can never touch the network, files, or clipboard on its own — the Rust core owns capture, recognition, and delivery.
